evidence.finding: Dedicated XV2 documentation identifies Breaker Energy Wave as a Ki Blast Ultimate used by Goku, available to CaCs; 0 Ki; PQ101 unlock; multi-hit beam; once-only use when opponent is at low health.

Technique documentation identifies Breaker Energy Wave as Xenoverse 2's name for Goku's Angry Kamehameha and states it is a Goku Ultimate Skill, 0 Ki, once-per-battle, low-health-gated, and available from PQ101 for the Future Warrior.
Maintained all-PQ guide explicitly lists Breaker Energy Wave in PQ101 Basic Reward.
Historical user answer reports that an Ultimate Finish was needed; this is experiential evidence and does not establish a formal reward-tier rule or probability.

resolution: Corrected stale canonical identity/mechanics fields from Super/Hit/100 Ki to Ultimate/Goku/0 Ki, while retaining PQ101 Basic Reward semantics. Historical Ultimate Finish acquisition reports are preserved as conflict context without inventing a drop probability.
evidence_boundaries: Basic Reward documentation and historical player reports conflict on acquisition conditions; no numeric drop rate is inferred.
Low-health behavior is described qualitatively as low health; no exact threshold is promoted from anecdotal reports.
No TP Medal Shop route was added because this bounded audit is anchored to the repository's PQ101 acquisition endpoint.
